name: banking77_cluster_full
description: 3080 tickets (full split) from laya-triage's data/external/test.csv — the canonical PolyAI BANKING77 test split, human-annotated intent labels mapped to the 12 clusters via laya_triage schema.py @ b15325e. Human-derived labels.

questions_schema.name: cluster
questions_schema.instructions: Which problem cluster does this ticket belong to?

criteria.card_ordering_and_delivery: ordering, activating or waiting for a new or replacement card
criteria.card_types_and_linking: card types (virtual, disposable), limits, wallet linking (Apple Pay, Google Pay), supported networks
criteria.card_and_pin_malfunctions: card or contactless not working, card swallowed by ATM, PIN blocked or change
criteria.card_payment_problems: card payment declined, pending, charged twice, reverted or not recognised
criteria.cash_and_atm: ATM or cash withdrawal: cannot withdraw, declined, pending, wrong amount received
criteria.transfers_and_beneficiaries: transfers failed, pending, cancelled or not received; beneficiary problems
criteria.top_ups_and_balance_updates: top-ups: failed, pending, not showing yet, limits; balance not updated after adding money
criteria.fees_charges_and_refunds: unexpected fees or charges, refund requested or missing
criteria.exchange_rates: exchange rates, exchange charges, currency conversion
criteria.identity_and_account_admin: identity verification (KYC), source of funds, passcode forgotten, edit personal details, account closure
criteria.lost_stolen_compromised: card or phone lost or stolen, account or card compromised
criteria.eligibility_and_coverage: eligibility to open an account: age limit, supported countries and currencies
